verdict.rationale: TeamViewer documents a Web API (teamviewer-docs-1), but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable machine-readable spec such as OpenAPI or Swagger. Probes of common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404 (teamviewer-probe-2). Human-readable API docs are adjacent and do not satisfy the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
